newsitem.title: FRANCE: Euro Disney set to raise some prices.
newsitem.headline: Euro Disney set to raise some prices.

text.p: Euro Disney expects to increase some of its prices while maintaining its competitivity, said chairman Gilles Pelisson in an interview with financial daily La Tribune.
"Now that we have a better knowledge of seasonal shifts in attendance, we are considering raising some of our prices by 1998, while maintaining our competitivity."
"Our entry price for an adult in high season is currently around 195 francs, and has not moved since 1995. This is not very high compared to the prices of other French leisure parks," he said.
He said he also wanted to increase partnership agreements with airlines.
He said he expected the opening of a second symposium centre last September would increase the percentage of corporate clients.
